claim: A private diagnostic boot-image set carries the verified R6 kernel and ABL DTBs with the previously inspected read-only rescue initramfs.
oracle: Independent AOSP unpacking recovers the exact kernel, DTBs and ramdisk; the ramdisk has no writable-partition allowlist, register-probe marker, display-trigger marker or modules; the command line keeps it in diagnostic initramfs.

user_journey.scenario: Recover phone control and boot a single diagnostic candidate while keeping slot A and the existing Omarchy root recoverable.
user_journey.expected: USB serial/SSH and read-only partition inspection become available before any driver activation or root filesystem migration.

invariants: Use existing inspected rescue init rather than changing storage guard
gitnexus: Unavailable; inspected storage guard, conditional probe and switch_root paths directly.
ast: Verified no writable allowlist or auto-load modules in selected rescue stage.

unit.red: R6 kernel/module outputs are not Android boot images.
unit.green: Offline pack/unpack passed: recovered kernel, concatenated ABL DTBs and rescue ramdisk match byte-for-byte. No allowlist, register probes, display trigger or external modules are present.

boundaries: kernel plus DTBs and rescue stage -> AOSP pack -> independent unpack -> real phone
evidence: AOSP header-v4 pack and independent unpack passed; boot image 20,197,376 bytes; vendor_boot 6,852,608 bytes; dtbo 4,096 bytes.
Private image outputs include the local SSH authorization material and are not published.

limitations: Offline packing is not permission to flash: current partition sizes, rollback headers, calibration backups, runtime watchdog and USB recovery still need verification.
This diagnostic image deliberately does not start the Omarchy desktop or activate external radio/camera modules.
exit_gate: Offline integrity checks plus recovered device state and verified recovery/backup gates before a hardware trial.
